_doc: Stream E. Settlement names for Vharlen on stream B's bake (tools/place-vignettes.mjs). Per E zone: `world` zone id; `rename` = B settlement/crossing id -> the name the sheet and quests use (B: impose at bake time, like Torborhold); `asks` = a settlement the sheet needs where the world has none (B: place a planned settlement of that kind and radius at x, z — zone metres — with that name; E's placements already keep clear of the circle). After B re-bakes, E re-runs the placer and asks that now exist drop out.
